reviews.title: Misleading Subscription - Be Careful
reviews.text:
The app occasionally sends you emails or notifications inviting you to take tests — like discovering your "starseed type" or getting more insights into your birth chart. After a long quiz, they ask for just €1 to access to your results — but what they don’t clearly tell you is that this small payment signs you up for a €40/month subscription.

If you pay with PayPal, the subscription doesn't appear in your Apple ID subscriptions, only on PayPal. Since the app only explains how to check Apple subscriptions, it’s very easy to miss – and that feels intentional.

I contacted their customer support multiple times, but received no real help. They even mentioned a possible refund on several occasions, but later went back on their word. I also reached out to PayPal to try and get a refund, but in the end, I got nothing: no refund, and no proper support from Nebula.

I ended up losing €40 for absolutely nothing. Very disappointing experience.

Sono andata a vedere nelle e-mail, c’era un e-mail alle 22.19 del giorno prima che mi avvertiva che alle 21.43 del giorno dopo mi avrebbero addebitato la fine di un periodo di prova che non avevo mai sottoscritto. Sono dei truffatori, state lontani. Anche cancellate questo fantomatico abbonamento è stato complicato ( infatti non risultava neanche tra periodi di prova e abbonamenti di Apple). Truffa
